item.title: Scrying the AMD GFX1250 LLVM Tea Leaves
item.description:
📝 A curious note here is that while we know that these accelerators are not APUs, they are listed as such in LLVM. GFX1250 operates only in Wave32 mode, unlike RDNA that can run in Wave64 in addition to Wave32 mode. This is an even larger improvement over the register allocation behavior of the RDNA series of GPUs, RDNA can only allocate up to 256 registers to a single Wave with no allocation split.
🔗 Read more: https://chipsandcheese.com/p/scrying-the-amd-gfx1250-llvm-tea
